findings.liveState: COORD D-226 (ADOPTED 2026-08-22), subject docs/coop/artifacts/harness.DR-G26.preview-analyze-sarif-not-advertised.preview.v2.json 3a6f13799ef960170370a2a74930d62778a9671b2065ac3e83ca485c21721ffb, Decision: "Record v2 as G26 occupancy remasurement after D-225." COORD D-251 (ADOPTED 2026-08-23) states verbatim: "Occupancy v2 is the current G26 occupancy remasurement. Occupancy v1 is not current." G26 v2 was recomputed live at 3a6f1379… and is unmoved. G26 v2's own registerRowNote closes with "Frozen v1 stays unmoved", confirming v1's status as a superseded predecessor.
findings.refutation: The subject's stated purpose is "Remasure sarif leftover-join.v4 to live HEAD 8bfcd02c36d28b079da2d29350beb6d3fac8168a and last heading D-324." sarif leftover-join.v4 cited G26 v1 lawfully: v4 was recorded at D-182 on 2026-08-21, one day before D-226 moved G26 occupancy custody to v2. That citation is therefore correct as of v4 and stale as of this candidate. A remasurement whose whole function is currency cannot carry an occupancy that COORD has expressly declared not current. This is not a wording preference; three consequences follow from the bytes: (1) remeasurementClause watches G26 v1 for movement, so the file whose movement should force a remasurement — G26 v2 — is unwatched; (2) obligations[OBL-G26].reason quotes v1's registerRowNote ("does not SATISFY DR-131 and does not restore G17") as the live note, whereas v2's registerRowNote carries materially more live standing, including "Live token remains OPEN. Live assurance stage remains PROPOSED; not QUALIFIED" and "It does not close leftover-design of OBL-G26-FX-AUTHORING"; (3) the subject states G26's review standing as "Claude ACCEPT 0/0; Codex not reviewed", while the live occupancy v2 carries two independent reviews (claude2 and codex both present on disk), so the stated standing understates live G26. The string "preview.v2" does not occur anywhere in the subject.
findings.notCuredBy: v4's dual ACCEPT 0/0 does not cure this. v4's reviews were taken at HEAD 4141d36 on 2026-08-21, before D-226 existed. The prompt's instruction not to edit G26 v1 protects that file from mutation; it does not certify v1 as the current occupancy.
findings.repairShape: Re-point the G26 occupancy citation to harness.DR-G26.preview-analyze-sarif-not-advertised.preview.v2.json 3a6f1379… (D-226), quote v2's registerRowNote and its live standing, state v2's dual-review standing, name v1 as the frozen superseded predecessor, add v2 and its two reviews to recordedInputs, and replace "G26 v1" with the current occupancy in remeasurementClause. Do not edit G26 v1 or G26 v2. This repair does not steal G26 leftover from DR-131 and does not SATISFY DR-122.

findings.refutation: The D-002 platform provenance for the DR-122 lineage is G10 occupancy v2, cross-checked against G23 occupancy v2 — recorded at D-296 and D-297, the very decisions this candidate remasures after. Naming G26 occupancy in the same breath as the per-D-002-platform remainder points a successor at an artifact with no platforms array, and "quoting occupancy platforms" leaves the source unnamed. findings.title: One unstemmed leftover-join version token survives the stemming pass.
findings.location: basedOn.predecessorJoin.role — "OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM and OBL-FC-OUTFAIL leftoverDesign true as unauthored fixtures at v2."
findings.subjectClaim: A leftover-join version is referenced in prose as the bare token "v2".
findings.liveState: The prompt's attack list names "an unstemmed leftover-join.vN prose token (sarif leftover-join.vN is stemmed)". The subject otherwise ran a complete stemming pass: all eighteen occurrences of v4's deictic "This join" were replaced with "sarif leftover-join.v5", and v4's unstemmed "leftover-join v1/v2/v3" and "leftover-join v3" were both stemmed away. Scanning the subject, every leftover-join prose token is stemmed — 39 "sarif leftover-join.v5", 9 "sarif leftover-join.v4", 1 "g21 leftover-join.v14" — except this one. The four sibling joins accepted and recorded under the current discipline (g19 leftover-join.v6, g20 leftover-join.v9, g21 leftover-join.v14, g30 leftover-join.v8) carry zero unstemmed version tokens; every bare vN in them is family-stemmed ("occupancy v2", "corpus v8", "G21 v3", "naming v6").
findings.refutation: The claim itself is true of sarif leftover-join.v2 and is not contradicted by bytes. The defect is carry safety, which is what the stemming rule exists for: lifted into a decision record, "leftoverDesign true as unauthored fixtures at v2" does not say v2 of which family — contract, golden, occupancy, or join all have live v2s in this corpus. The block-local path does not travel with the sentence. That the text is inherited verbatim from v4 does not cure it: v4 was reviewed under an attack list naming only "stale This vN self-version claims", a narrower rule that this sentence satisfies by ending "Not this artifact's version number." The v5 prompt tightened the rule, and the author's own near-complete stemming pass shows the tightened rule was being applied.
findings.repairShape: Write "as unauthored fixtures at sarif leftover-join.v2".

decision.rule: ACCEPT only if no MUST-FIX or SHOULD-FIX.
decision.reason: The candidate's measurement work is sound and its digest discipline is exact — 56 recomputed digests, zero mismatches, HEAD triple-matched, custody and last-heading claims clean, and every prohibition in the attack list honoured but one. It fails on currency, which is the one thing a remasurement exists to deliver: it pins G26 occupancy v1, an artifact COORD D-251 states in terms is "not current", and never names the occupancy D-226 recorded in its place. Two lesser defects travel with it: the per-D-002-platform route points at an occupancy holding no platforms instead of the G10 occupancy v2 its own goldens quote, and one leftover-join version token escaped an otherwise complete stemming pass.
decision.consequenceIfRecordedAsIs: DR-122's OBL-G26 measurement would rest on a superseded occupancy, and the remeasurement trigger set would watch the wrong file — so a future move of the live G26 occupancy would not force the remasurement it should.
decision.pathToAccept: Repair MF-1, SF-1 and SF-2 in a successor. None of the three requires opening Class A, closing leftover-design, editing file 08 or COORD, or minting any identifier.
